patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks the meaning of the precautionary principle (2024, 2025) and polluter pays (2025) as direct definition items.

Eco-Mark = environment-friendly products (asked by many PSCs); drugs excluded.
Generic sustainability items (inter-generational equity, conserving natural resources) appear in APPSC forestry papers.
App MCQs add case-law doctrine matching (Vellore, Kamal Nath, Oleum gas) which PYQs here do not show but is sound.
